baselines.description: Per-node isolated SQLite session store: each gunicorn worker uses isolated temp file /tmp/spider-pernode-<worker>.db (WAL, not shared) with same HS256 secret but no shared sessions. Real HTTP via nginx 127.0.0.1:19851 round-robin, 4-concurrency, SEED 44. Expected to replicate distributed failure: session_status TN=0.0, mean TN~0.667 (<0.85). Strong negative baseline proving failure is replication not algorithm. Must be real requests with X-Worker-Pid>=10 per worker, not synthetic.

Shared-store fix: single SQLite WAL file at /tmp/spider-runtime-35860330078/shared.db (WAL, shared across both workers, check_same_thread=False, COMMIT verified via SELECT per batch). Both workers connect to same file, HS256 shared-secret validates JWT via PyJWT decode to sessions row. Real HTTP via nginx round-robin, real If-None-Match/ETag->304, per-batch SELECT log >=27 lines. Expected TN>=0.85, n_non304>=800 stratified, r TOST within 0.15, X-Worker-Pid>=10 per worker. Primary intervention for H1.

Sticky-session fix (URL-bound, not round-robin): per-node DB files but nginx sticky affinity via hash $request_uri consistent or ip_hash with real client IPs (hash $remote_addr) ensuring same client/URL hits same worker >90%. Same HS256 secret per worker. Real HTTP with real IPs/URLs (not simulated skew). Expected TN>=0.85 as alternative to shared store if sticky works, distribution skewed >90% per worker, reported separately. Tests OR clause of mandate plus shared-secret replication.
Fingerprint = hash(status) only. Expected 0.0 on 200 vs 200 body-only and header-only via direct and via Playwright browser fetch (proves status confound removed). Stable ID for AUDIT recomputation.

Fingerprint = hash(decompressed body_bytes) only. Expected 1.0 deterministically on body-only AvsC (31B vs117B 86B) AvsB (70B vs31B 39B) and gradient 1B/2B/4B diffs (32vs31,33vs31,35vs31) via direct and via browser decompressed bodies, 0.0 on header-only AvsE (bodies identical 31B). Proves body signal when status constant.

Filtered headers including Content-Length. Expected via direct+BrowserGym: body-only 1.0 solely via CLEN (31 vs32/33/35/70/117) with headers-no-CLEN 0.0, header-only 1.0 via CC/ETag/SC/Vary with bodies identical 31B. Isolates body-correlated vs independent header signal for gradient ordering. Must be real browser fetches for browser arm.

Filtered headers minus Content-Length. Expected 0.0 on body-only AvsC/AvsB/gradients (no independent header drift), 1.0 on header-only AvsE and per-header isolations CC_small/large, ETag_small/large, SC_small/large, Vary_small when fetched via browser or direct. Critical isolation for sensitivity ordering (Cache-Control vs ETag vs Vary).

If any C1-C6 fails where validity passes => FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING bounded to failing branch (distributed vs browser). If shared-store and sticky both fail where per-node correctly fails via real HTTP => distributed FALSIFIED. If browser provision fails but distributed passes => MIXED (distributed SUPPORTS browser FALSIFIED/INVALID). If C2 power fails (<800) with C1/C3 passing => MEASUREMENT_INVALID underpowered not falsification. Any synthetic generation or relabeled direct-as-browser triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID per frozen falsifier, not SUPPORTS/FALSIFIED. Infrastructure-unavailable branches map to MEASUREMENT_INVALID: gunicorn/nginx unavailable, shared store file creation fails, Playwright not installable, CDP not available, AgentLab 0.4.2 missing, HS256 plumbing still rejects all valid => MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that branch while other branch can still be decided. Paid CDN absent NOT invalidity. Degenerate CI not invalidity.
